Ashurbanipal.notes: End date disputed: 631 BCE (conventional) vs 627 BCE (some sources). ORCC uses 631. Scoring tolerance ±5 yr.

Sennacherib.notes: Assassinated 681 BCE. ORCC encodes his death year.

Esarhaddon.notes: Only ruler in ORCC with year range across his fragments (669–681 = full 12-yr reign). All other NA rulers have single-year labels.

Sargon II.notes: Died 705 BCE in battle. ORCC encodes death year.

Nebuchadnezzar II.source: encyclopedic only (ORCC year=NaN for NB rulers)
Nebuchadnezzar II.notes: NB ruler — ORCC corpus has no year labels for Neo-Babylonian fragments. Cannot use for year regression.

Tiglath-pileser III.notes: ORCC spelling: 'Tiglath-pileser III' (lowercase p). ORCC encodes death year.

Nabonidus.source: encyclopedic only (ORCC year=NaN for NB rulers)
Nabonidus.notes: Last Neo-Babylonian king. Cyrus II conquered Babylon 539 BCE. ORCC has no year labels for NB fragments.

Sîn-šarru-iškun.notes: Last major Assyrian king before fall of Nineveh 612 BCE. Min class (21 frags) — sets MC draw size k=21. End date 612 is well-attested.

_meta.orcc_year_encoding: positive integer = year BCE (e.g. 668 = 668 BCE). NB rulers have year=NaN — excluded from year regression.
_meta.important_note: ORCC encodes a single representative year per NA ruler (typically death year). Within-ruler year variance = 0 for 5 of 6 NA rulers. Year regression on balanced subset is therefore not meaningful — collapse to ruler classification only.
